, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the controlled variable. To test the effect of air amount (independent variable), Ben must keep the drop distance constant across balls. Instead, the Planner chose to keep the air amount the same (which eliminates the variable under test) and suggested averaging out drop-height differences rather than controlling them, leading to the incorrect answer A instead of the correct B.
